claim: Detecting subagent dispatch via tool_use blocks named Agent/Task and subagent_type; parent_tool_use_id marks messages inside the subagent; Agent renamed from Task in v2.1.63; nested subagents since v2.1.172; the prompt string is the only parent->child channel; tool restrictions and troubleshooting delegation.
quote: To detect when a subagent is invoked, check for tool_use blocks where name is "Agent". Messages from within a subagent's context include a parent_tool_use_id field. The tool name was renamed from "Task" to "Agent" in Claude Code v2.1.63.

claim: Promptfoo claude-agent-sdk provider captures dispatches in metadata.toolCalls with parentToolUseId (non-null for subagent calls), normalises Skill calls into metadata.skillCalls, and forward_subagent_text exposes the nested transcript.
quote: parentToolUseId: Parent tool use ID for sub-agent calls, null for top-level. By default, only tool_use and tool_result blocks from subagents reach metadata.toolCalls. To capture the complete subagent transcript: forward_subagent_text: true

claim: Routing test pattern: positive prompts, near-miss prompts that should route to a sibling, and assert both the skill you want (skill-used) and the ones you do not want (not-skill-used); third layer confirms the chosen skill changed the actual work.
quote: Add nearby prompts that should route to a sibling instead, then assert both the skill you want and the skills you do not want.

claim: Claude uses each subagent's description to decide when to delegate; filesystem agents in .claude/agents/ load at startup only.
quote: Claude uses each subagent's description to decide when to delegate tasks. When you create a subagent, write a clear description so Claude knows when to use it.

claim: outputFormat/output_format json_schema yields a validated structured_output field, generated from Zod/Pydantic, with SDK re-prompting and an error_max_structured_output_retries result subtype on failure.
quote: When the agent finishes, the result message includes a structured_output field with validated data matching your schema. ... error_max_structured_output_retries: No valid output remained after multiple attempts.

claim: claude -p --output-format stream-json emits one JSON object per line with a type field and requires --verbose; tool_use blocks with name Task identify dispatches; parent_tool_use_id marks nested tasks.

With CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1, subagent spans nest under the parent's claude_code.tool span so the delegation chain is one trace; subagent invocations surface as PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks with tool_name=task.
quote: When the agent spawns a subagent through the Task tool, the subagent's llm_request and tool spans nest under the parent agent's claude_code.tool span, so the full delegation chain appears as one trace.

claim: Promptfoo is an open-source tool to test prompts, agents and RAGs with declarative configs and CI/CD integration.
quote: Test your prompts, agents, and RAGs. Red teaming/pentesting/vulnerability scanning for AI. Used by OpenAI and Anthropic.

claim: Claude Code OpenTelemetry gives three signal types: metrics, events, and traces connecting a prompt to model calls, tool calls, hook execution, and permission waits.
quote: OpenTelemetry gives Claude Code three signal types: metrics describe aggregate activity over time, events ... describe discrete actions, and traces connect a user prompt to the model calls, tool calls, hook execution, and permission waits.

claim: Regression since Claude Code v2.0.77 (filed 12 Jan 2026, still open): TaskOutput returns the raw JSONL session transcript instead of the subagent summary, breaking context isolation.
quote: TaskOutput returns raw JSONL transcript instead of subagent summary (regression in 2.0.77). Last Working Version: 2.0.76. First Broken Version: 2.0.77.

claim: Repo mirrors Claude Code's system prompt, built-in tool descriptions and sub-agent prompts (Plan/Explore/Task) per Claude Code version.
quote: All parts of Claude Code's system prompt, 27 builtin tool descriptions, sub agent prompts (Plan/Explore/Task) ... Updated for each Claude Code version.
